notes.title: May 16th Update Notes
notes.notes:
Added transitional images when entering mini-games.
Fixed the issue with save files on Win11 systems.

notes.title: Repair and update instructions on January 20
notes.notes:
Fixed some achievements that could not be unlocked.
Fixed the problem that the twelfth level in the game could not be triggered.

notes.title: Description of major update of game version
notes.notes:
Updated game version 1.0

Five new levels have been added to the game, and now there are 12 levels.
Fix the problem of UI interaction, such as clicking the button does not respond.
Added achievement function.

notes.title: The official version of the game will be delayed
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. No.25 wish you a happy holiday!
"Alien Maze" will be officially launched on January 20!
New levels will be updated before this launch. There will be a first discount for the official launch. Friends who have not yet purchased should seize the opportunity!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631090/Alien_Maze/

Due to some new technical problems after the version update, such as clicking the play button of the twelfth level has no response, and two or three achievements cannot be unlocked. The program brother is trying to repair it, so the time to put it on the shelf will be delayed. We're very sorry.
The official launch time will be notified in this announcement. Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Patch update instructions on January 10
notes.notes:
Improve the stability of the program and fix the animation errors of a few players.
 Add the quick unlock function.

notes.title: Update instructions on January 8
notes.notes:
Increased the movement speed of small squirrels in the maze.
 Reduce the delay of mouse operation during animation.
 Fix tile errors.
 Fixed an issue where some individual moves were too slow.
 Fixed full screen resolution adaptation.
 Fixed animation switching issue.
